tokens.v: Pull back until all four planes run out to the frame edges and it reads small at the seam where they converge. 50mm at f/5.6, camera high on the three-quarter, tilted down the fold. Catch it a half-second after the strap was released: the free tail still lifting a centimetre off the yellow plane, blur along that tail alone, its cast shadow separated from it by exactly that centimetre. A cobalt paper edge crosses the near bottom-left corner out of focus and is cut by the bottom edge.
